planets.name: TOI-481 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-481 with a 10.3-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-481 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-481. Its orbit and size follow Brahm et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
